content.short: STON.fi is a TON automated market maker and DEX for token swaps, liquidity pools, routing, and DeFi trading.
content.description: STON.fi is one of the core decentralized exchange protocols in the TON ecosystem. It provides automated market maker swaps, liquidity pools, routing, and DeFi trading tools for TON tokens, giving users and liquidity providers a native venue for exchanging assets on The Open Network. STON.fi is a decentralized automated market maker (AMM) built on the TON blockchain. Swap cryptocurrencies, stake tokens, provide liquidity on the TON blockchain. STON.fi is listed for the financial workflow it supports for traders, liquidity providers, borrowers, stakers, or yield users.
